## #2 — SurfingAlien — 2011-09-05
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7673/post-63415>

Hi Angel and welcome

to create grass you can simply use particles since 5.5

that said, scripts are a great add-on to cheetah so it's worth to spend some time to get them working.

using scripts is easy as: download the script, place it in the proper folder, call for it from the tools menu and tweak settings. of course some are quite straight forward and some others need a bit of adjusting but you'll be amazed by how many things you can do with them...

let's go though all the steps... did you buy cheetah on the MAS or via this website?

cheers,
Alessandro

## #23 — Francois — 2011-11-27
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7673/post-65342>

[[QUOTE:  Ibo said: ... The examples and the scripts folder I downloaded from this site: I'll keep them on my desktop till I know what to do. Click to expand... ]]

Please read again all the posts in this thread !
- examples files : *.jas files can stay on the desktop or anywhere on your disk
- script files : *.js files have to be in their own folder, depending on their type, eg :
- a polygon object script ( *.js file ) should go in folder "Ibo"/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3d/scripts/Polygonobj
- a macro script ( *.js file ) should go in folder "Ibo"/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3d/scripts/Macro
- same thing as above for Particle, Splineobj, Tag or Tool scripts

## #25 — tg_jp — 2011-11-28
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7673/post-65344>

hi

you can find 'scripts' folder at /Users/[ your home folder name ]/Library/Application Support/Cheetah3D/ . if you don't have 'scripts' folder in that location yet, you have to create new folder named 'scripts' though.

if you are using Cheetah3D on 10.7.x Lion, you cannot see Library folder by default, so to access that folder, you have to type /Users/[ your home folder name ]/Library at dialog of "Go to the folder" menu of Finder. please check a link below about it.

http://osxdaily.com/2011/07/22/access-user-library-folder-in-os-x-lion/

as François wrote, all script file ( .js file ) have to be copied certain folder, it depends on script type [ Macro/Polygon/Spline/Particle/Tool type ] . check the document or description on where you downloaded it from.

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

Links: http://osxdaily.com/2011/07/22/access-user-library-folder-in-os-x-lion/
